verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Pulumi serves a working llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a concise agent-oriented summary, and Pulumi also maintains extensive agent-oriented docs (MCP server docs, CLI docs) that AI assistants can be pointed at. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents successfully consume llms.txt in practice, and a docs.md/markdown-flavored docs endpoint (which returned 404).
